evaluation.statistics: Paired same-item bootstrap confidence intervals; repeats not independent cases
evaluation.failures: All missing/error/truncated attempts retained in complete denominators; no best-of/retry/refill selection
evaluation.economics: Authenticated usage joins including failed attempts; unknown costs or zero success -> null, not free. Also report full GPU lifecycle training/setup/idle/serve costs and concurrency1/8/32; no invoice, production-SLO or quality-equivalent ROI claim.
